title: Reproduction
description: The checked outcome of reproducing one reported bug (design part 2.2, step 3): kept as the message of the commit at refs/hitld/reproductions/<signal> when the bug was reproduced. The reproducer's reply, in $defs.reply, is untrusted output and is checked against it before anything uses it.

base.description: The commit the test fails on.

test.description: The test file, repository-relative, under a test directory.

failing.description: The tests in the file that failed on the base commit, by name, as the runner reported them.

expected_failure.description: The text the reproducer said the failure shows; the check found it in every failing run.

runs.description: How many sandboxed runs failed the same way.

failureText.description: A short piece of the error a failing run shows, such as the reported error message.

reply.description: The reproducer's reply: one JSON object. A reproduced bug names its test and the failure text; one that is not reproduced names what is missing and writes no test.

missing.description: What the report would need for a reproduction: the request for information is drafted from it.
